title: Number Bonds to 10 and 20
seo_title: Grade 1 Number Bonds Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Mental mathematics: number bonds to 10; add to 20 and subtract from 20; use the relationship between addition and subtraction.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 1 maths worksheets: number bonds to 10 and 20, ten frames and related subtraction facts. 100 questions with pictures and memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A number bond is two numbers that make a total: 6 and 4 make 10.
  • Use a ten frame: count the empty squares to see what is missing.
  • If 7 + 3 = 10, then 10 − 3 = 7.
  • 17 + 3 = 20 because 7 + 3 = 10.

Examples

Example

6 + ☐ = 10

6 and 4 make 10

Answer: 4

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
The wrong squaresCount the empty squares.
Off by one9 + 1 = 10, not 9 + 2.
Not using bondsUse 7 + 3 = 10 for 10 − 3.
